Committee: Healthcare
Sponsor: Coleman-Madison
Analyst: Bryan Young
Date: 02/22/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 116 introduced adds a consumer member to the Alabama State Board of Respiratory Therapy, which will increase the meeting expenses of the Board, and paid from the Alabama State Board of Respiratory Therapy Fund by an estimated minimum of $620.00 per year.
Jim McClendon, Chairperson
Healthcare
